And a good way to journal, reflect and have a digital space to do so. The report feature is really handy too. If you want to work on goals, they are easy to set up and tick off. And the achievement badges make things more fun.

has been a huge help in my life. I have a hard time communicating with other individuals around me, but  has made it a bit easier to open up. Cerebral issues: 1: They charged me a 124 dollar fee with out an explanation or reason why they did. They had my insurance as well btw. My monthly payment was only supposed to be 30 dollars a month. Hidden fees galore. 2: I was prescribed a low dose of Bupropion which seemed to help. Then they upped the dosage for no reason which made me even worse then when I wasn't taking anything. No quick fixes here. See an actual doctor or psychiatrist. This company will rip you off and get you addicted.

It's frustrating that the app is supposed to be able to keep track of your time at work, home, sleep, etc but the location permissions only allow it to get your location while the app is running. Everything has to be put in manually now.

The best helper out there I try to use it evetyday before i go to bed and it takes only 5-7 minutes to just state what feeling you are feeling and what stressors is causing it, this app does so much for your mental health and it is all so simple and not intrusive. With no price and no membership/paywall it is availible to all. If you are particularly busy you can miss a whole week and come back and the app will treat you great.This app has meditation and mindfulness routines and they are a very nice touch. I would recomend this app to anyone as just a way to manage stressors and how you feel. Just remember this app can help you but it is no substitute for a actual therapist. This is more of a companion app to help you, so if you or others need dire help or are thinking about self harm please call a therapist to talk to you and resolve the issues that you or your loved one is having. But overall this app is one of the best I have, there is so many resources that are so simple and user friendly that there is no reason to not to pick this up.(tip: set a reminder in the morning or right before you go to bed to track your feelingsand identify your stress so your sleep or rest of the day can be productive, you can set a alarm within the app)

The app is a good concept but a terrible experience to navigate through. As a listener the stuff I need most are never accessible, the hotlines and the exercises are never there. I have no access to the calendar and I can't make appointments either. The notifications don't work and the text is way too small. I have no way of getting to my profile either and there is no easy way to get back to the person I was talking to. Plus I have no access to the settings either. And for security: password protection.

It's not a bad app, but it's not for me. I appreciate being able to try it for free, but I can't be bothered to take up the premium trial because it kind of assumes a little too much about me at first, with the questionnaire. Others may have a better experience and this might be for them, so you should still give it a try.
